purpose: New Sprig appearance selected from the owner's Home Screen Heroes guide; mitten hand refinement

jobs.name: front-concept
jobs.reference: Owner conversation attachment: Bloomlings HOME SCREEN HEROES / Idle Animation Guide
jobs.prompt:
Create ONE beautiful standalone SPRIG character concept, faithfully based on the GREEN LEAF SPRITE shown in the attached Bloomlings reference board. The target is specifically Sprig in the LOWER LEFT GREEN CARD and the LEFT character beside the fountain. Extract and faithfully develop THAT adorable little character into a clean high quality full-body front view. Ignore all other characters, scene, logo, UI panels, text and animation arrows.

MATCH THE REFERENCE'S CHARACTER APPEAL AND PROPORTIONS, not a generic plastic toy or realistic plant:
- A VERY COMPACT, pudgy little garden sprite with a broad softly rounded-square pale pistachio face, full baby-like cheeks, a tiny pear-shaped body, extremely short little legs and rounded green feet. Head and leaves dominate, body is much smaller. No elongated torso or long human-like limbs.
- Large expressive dark chocolate eyes with gentle cream whites and small clean catchlights. Match the reference's sweet eye-to-face balance; do not inflate the eyes into giant black discs. Tiny green curved brows, subtle rosy cheek blush that softly fades into the skin, a tiny skin-colored button nose. Joyful open smile: a simple dark-brown mouth opening with a small coral tongue INSIDE. The mouth edge remains the same light-green skin color. No human lips, lipstick, lashes, eyeliner, nostril dots or makeup.
- The recognizable LEAF HAIRSTYLE from Sprig in the reference: a thick broad central pointed leaf swept gently diagonally over the forehead, layered smaller leaves on the temples and behind the head; a few wider leaves flare softly out around the sides and lower cheeks. Preserve the asymmetrical swept gesture and leafy woodland silhouette. Keep the leaf crown PROPORTIONATE and fairly COMPACT as in the reference, not an enormous tall spear dominating the image. Not a symmetric flower fan, lettuce ball, or two-leaf seedling antenna.
- LEAVES are clearly stylized premium GAME ART: plump sculptural planes, softly beveled edges, clean attractive green gradients, one shallow main vein and a few broad simplified folds at most. No realistic branching vein network, microtexture or botanical ribbing. Luminous spring-green edges, richer leaf-green roots; restrained saturation, never neon yellow-green.
- A little overlapping leaf collar covers the tiny chest, and two small side leaves sit like shoulder tufts, just like the reference. Soft rounded short arms with little four-digit cartoon hands (three short fingers and a thumb), no fingernails. Tiny feet with soft simple green toe caps, no shoes, no detailed human toes.

Show him standing straight front-facing, full body, feet slightly apart, head upright with no tilt, BOTH arms relaxed a little away from the body so the hands and collar are visible (not a formal stiff T-pose). Warm friendly smile, eyes looking straight at the viewer. No props, clothing, accessories or additional characters.

Rendering style must match the supplied board's lovely high quality cozy garden-game heroes: soft velvety SATIN materials with luminous gentle color and dimensional rounded forms, carefully controlled highlights, clean sculpting and warm emotional charm. No flat vector art, clay blobs, cheap glossy vinyl, wet face, specular plastic patches, photographic realism or extreme detail. Neutral soft studio illumination, creamy light pistachio skin harmonizing with rich green leaves; enough warm color to feel alive without an overall yellow cast. Plain very light warm cream background, tiny soft contact shadow beneath the feet, generous empty margin around the complete character. No text, labels, scenery, panels, sheets or turnarounds. This is a FIRST FRONT CONCEPT of the specific cute Sprig from the user's reference, not a full reference sheet or animation diagram. Prioritize matching the original example's charm and compact proportions.

jobs.name: mitten-hands
jobs.prompt:
Make a STRICTLY LOCAL EDIT to ONLY BOTH HANDS of the supplied approved Sprig character illustration. The owner approves this exact design and asks to simplify the crooked individual fingers into cute MITTEN HANDS.

Each hand must now consist of:
1) ONE smooth plump rounded OVAL PALM / MITTEN SHAPE, with the four fingers completely merged into ONE continuous smooth outer contour.
2) ONE small softly rounded THUMB protruding naturally from the upper-inner side of that palm, with a tiny clear notch between thumb and palm.
There are NO separately drawn fingers, no multiple knuckle bumps, no scalloped paw-like fingertips, no finger lines, no nails and no fist grooves. Just one simple soft palm and a little thumb. Both hands are naturally mirrored and the same small size. Keep the hands approximately the existing size or slightly smaller, in the SAME relaxed outward/downward arm positions, gently facing the viewer. Same pale pistachio skin color and soft satin surface as the arms. No gloves or fabric; these are the creature's actual little hands.

Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as in the supplied image: the newly approved exceptionally cute Sprig appearance, large softly square-round face, expressive dark brown eyes and catchlights, green eyebrows, tiny pale-green nose, joyful open smile with tongue inside, rosy cheeks, head proportions, asymmetric swept leaf quiff and all leaf shapes/positions/veins, leaf collar, tiny plump body, short legs, rounded green feet, pose, color palette, rich soft material finish, lighting, warm cream background, tiny ground shadow and full-body framing. Do not redesign, recolor, change proportions, simplify the leaves or change the facial expression. Do not add props, text or other views. One complete front-facing character. Only replace the fingers with a SINGLE SMOOTH PALM AND ONE THUMB on each side.
